description: This file defines the LeaveReportAPI class, which extends a base ReportAPI class to provide API endpoints for retrieving leave reports within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes mappings for report types, documentation annotations for API specification, and logic to instantiate the appropriate report class based on query parameters.

classes.name: LeaveReportAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoint for fetching various leave reports based on report name parameter, extending the generic ReportAPI to leverage common report functionalities.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Determines the report class based on the report name parameter and returns an instance of that report class, throwing a BadRequestException if the report name is invalid.
